_template: DEMO TEMPLATE. Retention periods and holds for a demo clinic with synthetic data. They are placeholders chosen to exercise the code, not legal advice and not any real clinic's policy. A real clinic sets them with its own adviser before any real data is loaded.
_review: Approved for demo use only — not legally reviewed and not production compliance evidence. (2026-09-22)
_sweep: retention.py deletes only the types marked sweep=delete. types marked report are counted and listed for a person to decide on; nothing clinical or fiscal is deleted automatically.

invoices.basis: demo placeholder for fiscal record-keeping; kept with the name and codice fiscale they were issued to

clinical_records.basis: demo placeholder; a real clinic's clinical-record duty must be confirmed by an adviser

audit_log.basis: demo placeholder; rows name patients only by surrogate id, which stops resolving after erasure

exports.basis: a copy handed to the patient; deleted after 24 hours

closed_data_requests.basis: demo placeholder; the record that a request was handled, with no personal details kept

call_recordings.basis: demo placeholder; nothing records calls yet (voice scheduling is P12) - named here because the recording consent text refers to this policy
